made-mobius-chess-ringmate.notes: PASS (round 2). The new stretch reads. What it is now: at 45.6 s the flag reaches the twist and drops under the board; from 45.7 to about 46.3 s the board opens. The underside parts downward from the top as a second solid ring, still joined to the top where the two bands cross at the twist, and the camera lowers. Nothing is see-through. Why a cold viewer reads two faces of one strip and not two boards: the lower ring comes out from under the upper one in view (45.85, 46.0, 46.15 s); the gold band runs unbroken from the top ring through the crossing into the lower ring; the flag hangs beneath the lower ring upside down, its letters mirrored; Larry leans over to look. Gold only grows. Looked at 45.7, 45.85, 46.0, 46.15, 46.4, 46.9, 47.4, 48.5, 49.9, 50.3, 50.6, 50.9, 51.4, 52.3, 53.4, 54.0 and 54.3 s: the first lap's gold stays solid gold on the top ring throughout; the lower ring fills square by square behind the flag; the top squares between the twist and Larry's seat are plainly blue from the moment the board opens and turn gold only as the flag crosses them (50.6 to 51.4 s). Both faces all gold are in full from 51.4 to 53.4 s, two seconds before the laugh, and the board closes all gold (54.0, 54.3 s). No rule is shown. No piece changes square: the pawns ride the top ring as it lifts and as the board makes its slow turn, together with the name flags; the only thing that travels is the flag, labelled Larry's. Larry's name flag is gone by 46.15 s and back at 48.5 s; nothing overlaps the flag hanging under his seat (46.4, 46.9, 47.4 s). The lamps sit on a black fill: LIKE, REPOST, LOVE read at 57.5 s and LIKE, REPOST, RESIGN on the last picture (75.5 s). Larry's question is captioned from "Meaning" (24.7 s). The wordless stretch still meets the measure: 42.4, 47.4 and 51.4 s differ; STUDIO SKETCH and the credit ringmate · mobius.mokkenstorm.dev · by @mokkenstorm.dev are on all of them; the only text is the four flags. The liberty the picture takes: the lower ring shows its squares to the camera while the flag hangs below it. It is a diagram of the underside under STUDIO SKETCH and claims nothing about the maker's game. Against the ledger: fresh; nothing the show has done is like the opened board. Not blocking: with both rings gold, LARRY'S SIDE stands directly above the LARRY name flag (51.4 to 54.3 s) and both read; the black fill behind the lamps cuts a rectangle out of his jacket. End card and title card (built-ins, packages/show/src/show/builtins.js): the two lines are gone from the roll. It still names the six real accounts by display name and handle (end, 24 s), says EVERY VOICE IN THIS PROGRAMME IS SYNTHESIZED BY CHIMERA and credits the synth and its author (32 s), and closes on GUESTS ARE PUPPETS PLAYING POSTING PERSONAS (38 s). reasons: For the final review. Sound: nobody has heard any of it, the three stretches and Sibyl's intoned meow included. The interview's hold on the label is the episode's one joke about the show: watch it in motion with sound, and weigh the close's four lines beside it. The experiment's second question: give each stretch to a cold viewer; the plotter and the coffee should hold, the chess only after its change. The plotter: how much of one account it carries (four cards, three read aloud, the name said three times), and three counts in one segment. Top Chicken: the row of three crowns can be taken for the week's whole field, though nothing says so; "Saturday" over a post dated 13 Nov; the card "Reply to @7778777.online" answers that account's second post in the thread, one minute after the one read before it; the spoken "cee" for the written "cee.wtf"; the sports desk and the crowned emblem that opens the segment come from the studio's kit, and the final review judges whether the segment reads as newly built. The coffee and chess segments: names and emoji are drawn by the viewer's own fonts, so look on a second device; the maker's display name looks provisional and must be read again from the profile at build. The title card (built-in): its episode line runs under Larry's mug and jacket and the date is crossed. The live pass the consent check still owes: every post still there and unchanged, and the counts at build.
